name: Production Job Shadowing
what_you_do: Shadow a team that helps put on a show, such as stage management, lights or sound. You learn how a show is made.
who_can_apply: Listed on the theatre's Teens page. No age or other rules are stated.
pay_detail: Not stated; described as job shadowing only.
duration: Not stated; you give your availability
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are listed.
how_to_apply: Email Associate Production Manager Todd Kalina at tkalina@childrenstheatre.org. Say which area you want to shadow. Say what you hope to learn. Say when you are free.
notes: The page also lists youth tryouts for student actors ages 8 to 18. Those roles are unpaid.
